description.sl: Čebelar Stanko pomaga znanstvenici iz Gradca šteti čebele: znanost in raziskovanje, eksperimenti in poskusi, teorije in hipoteze, dokazati, odkritja in izumi, študije in rezultati, vzroki, učinki in posledice, laboratorij, merjenje in meritve, statistika, povprečje in opažanja v majhnem zvezku.
description.en: Stanko the beekeeper helps a scientist from Graz count his bees: science and research, experiments and attempts, theories and hypotheses, proving, discoveries and inventions, studies and results, causes, effects and consequences, the lab, measuring and measurements, statistics, the average and observations in a little notebook.
description.it: Stanko, l'apicoltore, aiuta una scienziata di Graz a contare le api: scienza e ricerca, esperimenti e tentativi, teorie e ipotesi, dimostrare, scoperte e invenzioni, studi e risultati, cause, effetti e conseguenze, il laboratorio, misurare e misurazioni, la statistica, la media e le osservazioni in un quadernetto.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker
